what: First probe, not a validated detector. Score = ridges and hollows both nearby, 8 m cells.

candidates_check.what: S5 candidate sites (data/worlds/gale/candidates.json): a guide; the crew decides.
candidates_check.limits: Only 90 cells, all on Curiosity's own path; 'outside' is only the sulfate rock next door. Untested away from the rover's path. Rule fixed before the check (no tuning). Score, not a probability.

logistic_regression.split: 2 folds by sol: alternate blocks of 20 sols; standardised on the training fold only
logistic_regression.note: Neighbouring sols are neighbouring places, so blocks still leak space; the rule stays the baseline and the model ranks nothing on the map.

candidates_check.rule: top cells by score, reach == 1, round trip <= usable energy, >= 80 m apart; visited = within 24 m of a ChemCam/APXS point or a stop
